QuerySet builds a backend-checked structural AST, consumes the exact owned SQL/Values pair before awaiting driver execution, and uses generated executor methods. Instrumentation retains separate existing SQL/parameter samples; stream accounting and transaction connection ownership are preserved.
evidence: Three native PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite QuerySet scenarios passed typed predicates, precision-preserving decimal updates, bound pagination, pool/transaction reads and streams, row counts and delete.
356 pgvector-enabled query unit tests, 10 streaming tests, 44 typed aggregation SQL tests and one three-backend aggregation scenario passed.

Production/native-test Clippy, warning-denied rustdoc and 69 query doctests passed (4 ignored). Existing result/key defects #6530 and #6531 remain separately tracked; migration does not claim to repair them.
